messages:
Lena: Posted postmortem for recurring KV miss storms — looks like eviction cascades + delayed mitigation. Link: https://notion.redwood/pm/kv-miss-storm-2024
IncidentBot: New postmortem created by Lena. Please assign remediation owners and timelines.
Diego: We need a tiny urgent checklist for first 5 minutes with exact copy/paste cmds and an explicit 'do not trigger fallback' unless preflight passes. Current wording is too hand-wavy.
Priya: I'll own the preflight PromQL and the Grafana panel. Proposed preflight: spare_capacity_pct > 10 AND error_rate_1m < 1%.
Neha: I'll take the runbook rewrite. Plan: add a First-5 checklist, exact cmds, a "what to expect" note, and a short escalation ladder.
Lena: dropping quick commands to include:
```
# check redis memory + evictions
kubectl -n inference exec svc/cache-inspector -- redis-cli INFO memory | egrep 'used_memory|evicted_keys'
# check hitrate (promql)
(sum(rate(cache_hits_total[1m])) / sum(rate(cache_requests_total[1m]))) * 100
# current fallback state
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks | jq .status
```
Diego: I'll implement a wrapper script that runs the preflight, acquires a file lock, and only then posts the fallback trigger. Will test in staging.
Priya: I'll publish the Grafana panel and paste link in the runbook. Also will add the exact queries for spare_capacity and 1m error rate.
Neha: owners/due dates: Runbook PR -> Neha (due 2024-10-04); Wrapper script -> Diego (due 2024-10-02); Preflight + panel -> Priya (due 2024-10-03).
Lena: escalation ladder to include regional carve-outs (APAC fast path): 1) page eng-oncall via PagerDuty 2) if no ack in 3m escalate to eng-sre 3) if error rate > 5% for 10m page infra-leads.
Diego: I'll add a short "expected side effects" section so oncall knows cold-pool latency is normal after fallback.
Priya: also adding a quarterly audit ticket to ensure playbook still matches infra changes. Tagging 'recurring-incidents'.
Neha: opening runbook PR tonight and will tag reviewers. Please link any PRs to the postmortem tracker ticket.
IncidentBot: Follow-up meeting created for 2024-10-07 09:30 (invite sent). Reminder 48h prior.
Lena: thanks team — aim to close actions within two sprints.
